thread:
maya: Heads up — after the 4273 rollout we're seeing a sharp spike in compile queue and tail latencies on small-batch jobs. CI perf alerted ~09:12 UTC.

sam: saw that, alerted in #eng-sre. Any obvious culprit?

jorge: quick glance at CI artifacts: a ton of `compile_worker` churn and repeated kernel builds for the same model config. looks like autotune chose a different variant for short-seq path.

maya: exact. Attached profiler: flamegraph link: https://ci.redwood/test_runs/2150000000/flame.svg (CI artifact). main hotspot is autotuner compile loop + cache invalidation.

rachel: can you paste the small log snippet?

maya: sure — log:```
[09:10:12] compile_queue.enqueue model=redwood-1 size=8 seq_len=32
[09:10:12] compile:start model=redwood-1 variant=v2-int8-opt
[09:10:12] kvcache:invalidate key=redwood-1:shortseq:32
[09:10:12] compile:finish model=redwood-1 variant=v2-int8-opt time_ms=312
[09:10:12] request: fallback -> model=redwood-1 variant=v1-fp16
[09:10:13] compile:start model=redwood-1 variant=v1-fp16
[09:10:13] compile:finish model=redwood-1 variant=v1-fp16 time_ms=290
```

sam: hmm repeated invalidation then compile for different variants — smells like our heuristic that picks variant based on perf_estimate + recent_seq_len flipped due to a metric scale change in the rollout.

alex: which PR touched autotune scoring? 4273 was the release merge right?

maya: yes, 4273 merged autotune-priority refactor (author: @rachel). The change normalized latencies by p99 instead of median for short sequences.

jorge: that normalization could bump preference towards int8-opt for some shapes, which triggers cold compilations when cache keys include quantization variant. we saw dedup key format change in the same release.

rachel: i did adjust scoring — the intent was to bias against high-tail models. didn't expect it to flip picks for short batches. my bad, will revert if that's safest.

sam: before revert can we bisect to confirm? We need to prove correlation. I can run a CI bisect across the last 5 merges and capture compile churn metric.

maya: yes please. quick diagnostic to run locally: run smallseq repro with `AUTOTUNE_LOG=debug AUTOTUNE_SEED=42` and collect `/tmp/autotune_trace.json`. Also check `kvcache:key_format` — if key includes variant then we create separate entries.

alex: i'll run the local repro now and dump traces.

infra-bot: Deployment 4273 -> production completed at 09:05 UTC. No rollback requested.

jorge: if key format changed, that explains cache miss explosion — we'd be compiling both v2-int8-opt and v1-fp16 for same logical workload. Need to either unify key (strip quant flag) or prefer fallback variants that reuse existing cache.

rachel: quick thought — revert normalization in scoring (PR 4285) for now, then open a follow-up to tweak key format and add regression test. revert would be trivial and buys time. thoughts?

sam: +1 for revert as an emergency mitigation. We should also add a CI perf test that simulates mixed batches and checks compile_count delta < 2x.

maya: agree. i'll open a rollback PR and a perf test ticket. tagging @eng-sre to watch rollout.

alex: repro run complete, attaching trace snippet:```
{
  "autotune_picks": ["v2-int8-opt","v1-fp16","v2-int8-opt"],
  "compile_count": 67,
  "kvcache_misses": 420
}
```

jorge: that compile_count is ~6x baseline on shortseq CI. solid repro.

rachel: rolling back normalization now (PR 4286). will push and request a hotfix deploy.

sam: once rollback is in, let's monitor compile_queue length and p99 token latency for 30m before unblocking rollout.

maya: created ticket PERF-847 "autotune normalization caused variant flip -> compile surge" and linked traces.

infra-bot: Hotfix build 4286 started. ETA ~8m.

alex: after rollback we should also run a limited canary against dedicated pool to validate no latency regression.

rachel: agreed. will schedule canary job and add a unit test asserting stable variant pick for short sequences under seed 42.

sam: thanks all — keep updates here. if rollback doesn't fix, we'll bisect deeper into key-format changes. :thumbsup:

maya: update 09:35 UTC — hotfix deployed, compile_queue back to baseline in first 5 minutes. will keep monitoring.

rachel: leaving a postmortem note in #postmortems after we stabilize.

maya: closing for now, will reopen if we see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
